title: Signal: Dynamic code evaluation via load (lua) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the load call in lua code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any load call matches, including trusted uses such as local tooling. Whether the evaluated string is attacker-controlled needs human review.
fpNotes: Build scripts, REPL helpers, and test harnesses evaluating trusted strings are the common false positives.
